purpose: Prevent visibility, material, GI/lightmap, lighting-probe, transform or renderer-state discontinuities when DanchiHighDetail cross-fades from physical source renderers to LOD1/2/3 proxies. This is implementation/runtime readiness QA only and awards no Visual Fidelity points without native rendered evidence.

sourceClassificationPolicy.rationale: The 340 mm clothes-pole support arm remains facade-depth silhouette geometry after the smaller receiver and mounting hardware become sub-pixel.

proxyStatePolicy.runtimeLightmapStatePersistenceCaveat: Unity owns editor/runtime lightmap index and scale-offset assignment after scene load; therefore formal pre-cull must revalidate these transient values rather than trusting the generation-time copy.

visibilityIntent.rationale: A freshly created proxy defaults to visible. Without explicit parity, disabled legacy/alternate geometry can appear only after an LOD transition and become a benchmark-frame critical defect.

giAndVertexIntent.rationale: Additional vertex streams may override normals, tangents, colors or UVs. GI/lightmap state changes can produce exposure, contact or light-leak jumps during a cross-fade even with identical mesh/material references.

failureInjection: move one LOD proxy by more than 0.5 mm and require FAIL before formal capture
replace one proxy mesh or material and require FAIL
disable one physical source retained into LOD1+ while forcing its proxy visible and require FAIL
place a retained source under an inactive parent while leaving its proxy active and require FAIL
change one proxy rendering-layer mask or Light Probe Proxy Volume override and require FAIL
change one proxy additionalVertexStreams reference and require FAIL
change one proxy ReceiveGI, scaleInLightmap or stitchLightmapSeams value and require FAIL
change one proxy baked/realtime lightmap index or scale-offset and require FAIL
change one proxy reflection/light-probe policy or probe anchor and require FAIL
clear a source-derived proxy MaterialPropertyBlock while the source retains one and require FAIL
change a proxy motion-vector/occlusion/sorting state and require FAIL
classify HD_ClothesBracket_* only through LOD1 and require FAIL through the clothes-hardware closure/LOD policy
leave any declared LOD renderer outside its canonical HD_LOD1/2/3_Proxy root and require FAIL
